notProved: FA-277 does not field-securely prove the concrete values for Depreciation Starting Date, No. of Depreciation Years, Depreciation Ending Date or Last Depreciation Date.
FA-277 does not prove that the missing FADEP-273-OK journal output is caused by empty depreciation-book values.

reviewFindings.summary: Page Inspection and card text show field labels, but the exact field values remain unproven. The book must not treat visible labels as values.
Repeating Calculate Depreciation OK would be a blind rerun because no depreciation journal line is visible and key due-depreciation values are unresolved.
Existing tests FA-029/031 contain a caption-control field-value mapper. Reusing that pattern read-only is a smaller and safer next step than setup or posting.
